note: Every other field is documentation for humans and for the E2.1/E2.2 classifiers; engine.facets has no column for it.

facets.label: Type
facets.drives: competitor exclusion (operates at this level only) and the Row 1 complementary pool
facets.notes: Exactly the eight L1 nodes of the §4 type tree. Consumers that need the exclusion enum read the `type` facet's terms and must get eight rows.

facets.label: Subtype
facets.notes: L2 of the §4 type tree. Every subtype term's parent_id points at a `type` term (a cross-facet parent; the seed loader enforces it). Slugs are unique within this facet, hence `boutique-hotel` vs `boutique`.

facets.label: Location
facets.drives: Row 2 nearby fallback when geo is missing, area clustering, reader filters, /{section}/{area} URLs
facets.notes: root (indonesia) -> city -> district -> neighbourhood. Selecting a parent includes its descendants (§9). The district/neighbourhood node is the fallback when geocoding is missing (§4).

facets.label: Format
facets.drives: type-aware freshness decay (see format_decay.json) and layout
facets.notes: The shape of the piece, independent of what it is about. A hotel can be the subject of news, an offer, a review or a guide.

facets.label: Cuisine
facets.drives: restaurant matching, reader filter (shown only when type = eat)

facets.label: Vibe
facets.drives: vibe overlap in Row 1 compatibility, reader filter

facets.label: Amenities
facets.drives: reader filter, §8.B party constraints (kids, accessibility, halal, vegetarian)

facets.label: Topic
facets.drives: subject-matter tagging across every type; most legacy WP categories that are not a venue type land here
